description: This file defines the PromotionalScheme document class and related functions for managing promotional schemes, pricing rules, and discounts within an ERP system, including validation, update, and deletion logic.

classes.name: TransactionExists
classes.description: Custom validation error class for transaction existence conflicts.

classes.name: PromotionalScheme
classes.description: Document class representing a promotional scheme with validation and update methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the promotional scheme, ensuring required fields are set and related rules are consistent.

methods.name: validate_applicable_for
methods.description: Validates the 'applicable_for' field if set, ensuring the referenced field exists.

methods.name: validate_pricing_rules
methods.description: Validates related pricing rules, deleting or raising errors if conflicts are found.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Handles logic to update related pricing rules when the promotional scheme is updated.

methods.name: update_pricing_rules
methods.description: Creates or updates pricing rule documents based on current promotional scheme data.

methods.name: on_trash
methods.description: Deletes associated pricing rules when the promotional scheme is deleted.
